title: Audit log
intro: Who changed what in your organization, when, and from where.
empty: Nothing has been recorded yet. Changes to staff, roles and settings appear here as people make them.
emptyRecord: Nothing has been recorded about this record.
recordHistory: {kind, select, member {This staff member's history} role {This role's history} organization {The organization's history} subscription {The subscription's history} issued_document {This document's history} other {This record's history}}
oneRecord: {kind, select, member {The history of one staff member} role {The history of one role} organization {The organization's history} subscription {The subscription's history} issued_document {The history of one document} other {The history of one record}}

staff.invited: Invited a staff member to choose a password
staff.password-reset: Gave a staff member a new temporary password

settings.two-factor-requirement-changed: Changed whether everyone must use two-factor sign-in

support.impersonation-started: Started signing in as a staff member
support.impersonation-stopped: Stopped signing in as a staff member

subscription.overrides-changed: Changed the subscription's extra seats, price or modules
subscription.paid-through-changed: Changed the date the subscription is paid until
subscription.status-changed: Moved the subscription to its next state

subject.erased: Erased a person's or record's personal data
